adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no embed exists it unconditionally does `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ... embed_url: embed_url)` and renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The `loading.html.erb` template reloads the page every 30s, so repeated client reloads will enqueue additional `RetrieveTopic` jobs with no enqueue-side dedup/throttling. `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` does not set `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so exceptions from `TopicEmbed.import_remote`/`open(url)` can trigger Sidekiq retries. While `TopicRetriever` has a 60s Redis throttle that can make extra jobs no-op, the diff still shows a realistic queue-growth/perf risk from repeated enqueues rather than a direct correctness failure.
